text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...*yaaawn*... Oops, I'm sorry.
That was rather unbecoming of me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I'm ashamed to admit it, but...
I spent my day off going cycling, and—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by so much nature, sunsets, starry skies... The breathtaking scenery got me so excited that I had trouble falling asleep...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, I will carry out my schedule properly.
Please do not worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Ikuno Dictus wasn't able to rest properly.
